title: Use the Formula For Momentum
text: Use $$p=mv$$ to calculate the initial momentum.

title: Use the Formula For Kinematic Relations
text: Use $$t=\frac{2d}{v}$$ from the kinematic relations to calculate $$t$$.

title: Use Formula for the Change in Momentum
text: Use $$\Delta{}p=F\Delta{}t$$ to calculate the average force $$F$$.
